digest.component_or_area: CI/CD workflow — optionality lane degradation-path test step
propositions: The degradation-path test step in _optionality.yml clean-core-wheel job runs pytest against two test files without independent predates-gate guards, causing pytest exit 4 when patchset base predates either file
A patchset predating a test file causes pytest to collect nothing and exit 4, triggering Verified -1 from the gate rather than from the change under review, identical to bug 1909-c1a7-9f20-440f
Two test files must be guarded independently so a tree with one file but not the other still runs the present file
The step must carry a per-file -f guard and skip only absent test files, preserving the canonical predates-gate message
Fix: each test file receives its own if-present guard pattern; pytest node-id list is built only from files that exist; both-absent exits 0 before pip install
